dispositions.topic_text: Durability and post-rename failure semantics for placement and mark records
dispositions.what: delivery_store note (State 7): a record is synchronised after its rename; a failure there does not undo it (A6 rule 3: a record in place is the operation's effect).

dispositions.topic_text: Durability boundary and synchronization-failure semantics for stored images
dispositions.what: delivery_store note (State 7): durable means the image file synchronised, then each folder created for it in its parent and its own folder after the rename; any failure fails the write.

dispositions.topic_text: Temporary-file naming, exclusive creation, permissions, collisions, and crash cleanup
dispositions.what: delivery_store note (State 7): temporary names: fresh, exclusive, TEMPORARY_FILE_MODE, a taken name passed over; a crash remnant stays and is never read.

dispositions.topic_text: Project-lock failure classification and validation of an existing lock entry
dispositions.what: delivery_store note (State 7): the lock file is created exclusively or, when it exists, opened as it stands without following a link; a link or non-regular entry, or a failure to open or lock, is state_unavailable.

dispositions.topic_text: Race-safe creation and validation of missing shared folders
dispositions.what: delivery_store note (State 7): a folder another process created first is accepted when it is a folder.

dispositions.topic_text: Absent-versus-state_unavailable classification for invalid intermediate state-path entries
dispositions.what: delivery_store note (State 7): a missing folder on a record's address is an absent record; a link or non-folder on it is state_unavailable.

dispositions.topic_text: Whether symbolic links are permitted in the configured state_dir path
dispositions.what: delivery_store note (State 7): the configured state folder path is opened as it stands, also through a link; only what lies below it is walked without following a link.
